notes.cap: HEZE that can ever be issued across every deck; a unit of account inside the files, never a token
notes.awayHours: the most time a deck will catch up on when you come back
notes.secondsPerDay: how long a day is, in real seconds
notes.prosperityBase: prosperity with everyone housed and nobody fed
notes.prosperityFed: prosperity added when everyone housed is fed
notes.keepDefault: share of a trade's pay kept with no lane built
notes.noteThreshold: grain arriving below this is not written in the record

text: The rulebook of the village. Keep a changed copy in the browser through the editor in the quarter and the village plays by it on its next load; write it into the yard and it plays by it for good.
